programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: A truck driver is pursued by a blackmailing traffic cop, who chases him across multiple state lines, so he joins forces with other disgruntled truckers.

programme.title: A Fistful of Dollars
programme.desc: In the Old West, a mysterious stranger with no name and a clouded past wanders into a border town, where two families are engaged in a bitter land battle.

programme.title: Gunfight in Black Horse Canyon
programme.desc: Just released from a 10-year prison term, an outlaw seeks revenge on the Wells Fargo agent who sent him there.

programme.title: Meet John Doe
programme.desc: A naive homeless man is hired by a reporter to pose as a story's subject, and later to spearhead a national goodwill drive to benefit a corrupt politician.

programme.title: Something Big
programme.desc: An aging bandit longing for one last adventure before moving back with his fiancé attempts to acquire a Gatling gun in order to ransack a bandit treasure hoard.

programme.title: The Producers
programme.desc: Bumbling Broadway producers hatch an insurance scam that involves creating a guaranteed flop, but things do not go exactly as planned.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: A former prisoner of war in Korea begins to suspect that communists brainwashed his best friend and programmed him to become a deadly assassin.

programme.title: Bye Bye Birdie
programme.desc: A songwriter believes he can make his fortune and get the girl of his dreams by promoting a televised farewell concert for a rising rock-and-roll star.

programme.title: Road to Utopia
programme.desc: Two buddies find a map to a map to a secret gold mine and head to Alaska and pretend to be notorious escaped killers in order to locate it.

programme.title: Notorious
programme.desc: A frivolous young woman is approached by a United States government agent, who asks her to spy on her father's Nazi friends at great personal risk.

programme.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
programme.desc: An honest, respected Southern lawyer risks his career when he decides to defend a black man wrongfully accused of raping a young white woman.

programme.title: The Long, Long Trailer
programme.desc: Two newlyweds purchase a mobile home to spend their honeymoon traveling the country, but a series of misadventures nearly destroys their marriage.

programme.title: Woman of the Year
programme.desc: A renowned political columnist and a sports reporter, who work at the same newspaper but have nothing in common, try to overcome their differences.

programme.title: Descending S01 E01 - The Rest of the Map
programme.desc: Seasoned travelers Scott Wilson and Andre Dupuis begin a new journey descending into the world beneath the waves. They travel to New Zealand to recruit friend and fellow explorer Ellis Emmett for the adventure. But equipment challenges and harsh weather impede the team’s first dives.

programme.title: Ben Fogle S02 E05 - From City Life to the Scottish Countryside
programme.desc: Ben Fogle spends a year following 63-year-old Rizia as she swaps city living and life as a B&Ber in Edinburgh to follow her dream of living in the Scottish countryside and starting her own dog training center in the beautiful Pentland Hills in West Lothian, Scotland, with help from her 2 grown up sons Fireman Josh and builder Kyle, who are spending every spare hour helping her start up her dream business.

programme.title: Survival Of The Species S01 E05 - Poaching
programme.desc: How close is the African Rhino to extinction? Ben finds out.

programme.title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers S01 E01 - Charleston, SC NB
programme.desc: Matt and Ted Lee show off the best bites and sights in their hometown of Charleston, South Carolina, from Lowcountry oyster roasts to an undersea winery.

programme.title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers S01 E02 - Atlanta, GA NB
programme.desc: Matt and Ted Lee discover the international flavors of Atlanta, from Southern meets Asian “Seoul” food to globally inspired ice pops and redefined airport dining.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E105 - Vegetable Restaurant, Beer, Steak, Moussaka
programme.desc: Food Secrets – German Beer Bistecca alla Fiorentina: Florentine Steak. The Best Vegetable Restaurant in the World Trentino’s Apple Road. The Taste of Greece: Moussaka, the Eggplant Casserole.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E106 - Bohemian Dumplings, Vegan Cheese, Asparagus
programme.desc: Bohemian Dumplings: Traditional and Filling. Ham Baked in Bread: Dining Like the Ancient Romans. Vegan Cheese Alternatives from Switzerland. Crêpe Suzette from Monaco Little Specialty, Big Hit: The Lleida Snail. Festival White Asparagus - Why do Germans Love it so Much?

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E107 - Swiss Fondue, Buckwheat Whisky, Bread
programme.desc: The Secret Behind Champagne. Cheese Fondue – The Swiss National Dish German Bread. Whisky Made from Buckwheat. What Makes up a Typical English Breakfast? Scettro del Re: Deliciously Exclusive Ice Cream.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E108 - Cheese Fondue, Champagne, English Breakfast
programme.desc: A French Citrus Garden of Eden Kaiserschmarrn – An Imperial Dish Cabrales. Cheese: A Spanish Specialty Aged in Caves. Jellyfish: A Delicacy and New Superfood? Food Secrets: Volga-Style Russian Borscht The Chef and the Art of the Open Flame.

programme.title: Wildest Places S01 E03 - Barrier Reefs
programme.desc: Off the east coast of Australia lies the world’s largest living structure – the Great Barrier Reef, which is home to curious residents and seasonal visitors.

programme.title: Wildest Places S01 E04 - Islands
programme.desc: There are 25,000 islands in the vast Pacific Ocean. From palm-lined pristine white beaches to cold rocky outcrops, each one fosters its own ecology with unique rules and behaviours.

programme.title: Wildest Places S02 E01 - Currents
programme.desc: Hundreds of millions of years of volcanic activity, isolation and powerful currents have shaped Antarctica and its surrounding islands into varied and fascinating terrains.

programme.title: Art & The City S01 E05 - London
programme.desc: David Keeps explores London’s vibrant art scene from edgy Camberwell hotels and Tate Modern bridges to royal relics and Hoxton galleries uncovering creative contrasts in a city where ancient tradition and modern expression collide with wit.

programme.title: Art & The City S01 E06 - Los Angeles
programme.desc: David Keeps explores Los Angeles’s creative energy from cutting edge Culver City galleries and Disney Hall to the Getty’s bold exhibits and Chinatown’s emerging scene revealing how art, architecture, and personality fuel this sprawling cultural capital.

programme.title: American Canvas S01 E03 - Miami
programme.desc: Dave Holmes explores Miami’s dynamic cultural scene, from the international art spectacle of Art Basel to Little Havana’s rich culinary traditions, Wynwood’s street art, quickie couture fashion, flamenco dance, and dazzling Art Deco architecture.

programme.title: Euromaxx Architecture E61 - Iceland to Greece: Homes Aglow
programme.desc: Historical Apartment Meets Ethnic Furnishings A Remodeled 1960s Bungalow in Iceland Living in a Pyramid House A Seafront Vacation Home in Greece A ‘Villa Villekulla’ in Lyon All Lit Up: The “Luminale” Festival

programme.title: Euromaxx Architecture E62 - Concrete Cool Meets Chalet Charm
programme.desc: Brutalist Architecture Makes a Comeback Apartment Blends the Retro and the Modern Concrete: A Stylish Construction Material A Restored Alpine Chalet Living With the Blues Villa Delta: Living in a Triangle

programme.title: Race Across The World S02 E07 - Jungle Run Versus Bay Paddle NB
programme.desc: With two teams at the checkpoint –Ilha Grande in Brazil – the two remaining teams are engaged in a frantic race to avoid finishing the leg in last place. Dom and Lizzie are on foot, running through the jungle whilst Jo and Sam are paddling furiously in a canoe across the bay. It’s a nail-biting ending and the siblings just manage to edge out their rivals and sign into the book.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E13 - European Islands
programme.desc: Discover the green island of Ireland, find out why the inhabitants of La Gomera like to whistle, enjoy the view from the highest rock in Europe on Madeira and take a donkey taxi on the small Greek island of Hydra.

programme.title: Race Across The World S02 E08 - Final Push To The Edge NB
programme.desc: After twenty-one thousand kilometres, two continents and seventeen countries. The teams embark on the final leg of their epic journey. However, a mammoth 4800km still stands between them and the finish line of Ushuaia, Argentina, the most southerly city in the world.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E18 - Germany In A Nutshell
programme.desc: Would you like to get to know Germany better? Then come along and find out what it means to work, study and get married in Germany.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E03 - India Part 3
programme.desc: Gordon heads south to the coasts of Kerala for the ultimate seafood curry. In Tamil Nadu he hits a meat-free zone and faces his biggest culinary nightmare, living in an ashram where the only food on the menu is vegetarian. Any tranquillity soon evaporates when Gordon tries his highest-octane sport yet - bullock racing - before his final stop in the slums of Mumbai. There he cooks on Slumdog Millionaire streets before putting himself to the ultimate test, cooking alongside one of India's top chefs for a star-studded dinner at the Taj Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E03 Tumeric
programme.desc: Journey alongside Lauren as she delves into the vibrant world of turmeric. From infusing it into dishes like Urap Pakis to crafting a healthful elixir called Jamu, discover the captivating flavors against the breathtaking backdrop of Mount Agung.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E04 Nut
programme.desc: Join Lauren on a culinary adventure with various nuts as she discovers their potential beyond snacking and incorporates them into Italian and Balinese recipes like Cashew cheese, mouthwatering Cabonara and more delightful flavors.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E101 - Asma Khan, Fettuccine, Gouda, Pralines
programme.desc: The Sweet Secret Behind Belgian. Pralines Truffle Seaweed: The New Superfood? Celebrity Chef Asma Khan: Cooking up Social Change. Dutch Gouda: A Treat the World Over Tasty. Legacies: Fettuccine Alfredo The Sound of Wine.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E102 - Calum Franklin, Nougat, Mustard, Pizza
programme.desc: As Easy as Pie: Calum Franklin’s Culinary Delights. Turin, Home of Nougat. Dessert with Mustard: The Pastry Art of Hannes Radeck. Where Everything’s Made of Apples: The Route du Cidre Success Story: Pizza Baker Ibrahim Songne.

programme.title: Beach Battles S01 E03 - Winchester Bay Long Beach
programme.desc: High-octane dune racing in Winchester Bay, Oregon, plus high-flying Kitefest fun in Long Beach, Washington.

programme.title: Beach Battles S01 E04 - Pacifica Crisfield
programme.desc: Paddle into Dog Surfing in Pacifica, California, and get picking at the Crab Derby in Crisfield, Maryland.

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation S01 E02 - New Orleans Louisiana NB
programme.desc: The family explores the vibrant culture, food, and music of the city, likely experiencing the French Quarter and Louisiana cuisine.

programme.title: Into Americas Wild NB
programme.desc: Narrated by Morgan Freeman, this documentary short takes viewers on a scenic, fast-paced journey through the United States' natural wonders. The film emphasizes the connection between humans and nature, exploring locations from the Alaskan wilderness to the Appalachian Trail and Utah's canyons.

programme.title: American Beats S01 E01 - Lafayette, Louisiana
programme.desc: Chunz and Makh visit Lafayette, Louisiana where they take a deep dive into Zydeco music and local crawfish with Grammy-winning musician Chubby.

programme.title: American Beats S01 E02 - St. Louis, Missouri
programme.desc: While visiting St. Louis, Missouri, Chunz and Makh explore the soulful Blues community and take a turn jookin’ and ballroomin’ dancing.

programme.title: Travel Man S09 E01 - 48 Hours In Dubrovik
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and Stephen Merchant explore Dubrovnik, diving into Game of Thrones lore, sampling oysters, surviving a muddy buggy ride, and navigating Croatian quirks—all with biting humor and deadpan charm.

programme.title: Travel Man S09 E02 - 48 Hours Bergen
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and Lou Sanders explore Bergen, Norway—from misty mountains and seafood foraging to zip-lining and eco-tree planting—mixing Nordic charm, deadpan wit, and unpredictable antics in a uniquely offbeat travel adventure.

programme.title: Travel Man S09 E03 - 48 Hours In Krakow
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and Joe Wilkinson explore Kraków’s quirky treasures—from medieval squares and salty mines to dumpling feasts, vodka tastings, and stained glass art—serving deadpan laughs with a side of cultural curiosity.

programme.title: Travel Man S09 E04 - 48 Hours In Madrid
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade and Ellie Taylor race through Madrid’s museums, violet candies, ham-carving rituals, and surreal sermons—balancing art, history, and absurdity with deadpan charm, all under the searing Spanish sun and a swirl of cured pork.

programme.title: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: An action-packed, waking nightmare of relentless brutality and merciless revenge, set against the harsh landscape of rural Australia.

programme.title: On the Edge of Time
programme.desc: The creative crisis of poet Wolfgang Hanebrecht almost ended fatally, but the fool in him did not let himself get down.

programme.title: Frantic
programme.desc: In a Japanese theatre, an audience of two hundred people watch a play. It quickly becomes clear that events onstage are going off-script, building to the players locking the doors and trapping everyone inside.

programme.title: Rappacini's Daughter
programme.desc: A young student wonders about the beautiful gardens and even more beautiful daughter of Rappacini. And is horrified when he discovers the poisonous nature of their beauty.

programme.title: Global Meltdown
programme.desc: A helicopter pilot and an environmental scientist lead an exodus of survivors in a search for safe haven after a catastrophic tectonic event causes the crust of the earth to break apart.

programme.title: At 23,000 Feet
programme.desc: What does it take to reach the top of the world? A question everyone once in their life always thinks After creating the first world record of fastest climb on Black Peak Mountain which is at an altitude of 6387 meters in 6 days, Kovid Mittal is all set to climb 23000 feet mountain, his last chapter before he climbs Mount Everest, but will he be able to climb this 23000 feet monster despite his little to no experience ? A Journey of a young boy battling his own emotions and demons in hope that one day he shall climb Mount Everest.

programme.title: The Living
programme.desc: A man hires an ex-con to kill his sister's abusive husband, but the desperate act sets into motion a shocking series of events in this intense indie drama.

programme.title: Soul Man
programme.desc: Iris, a ballet dancer, reunites with Otis, an old friend with a mysterious alternate personality after years in a psychiatric hospital. Released and warned of his potential violence, they become vigilantes targeting crime and corruption. As they confront powerful criminals and strange entities, they must flee to survive. In a final battle, Otis faces his true identity and the forces pursuing them.

programme.title: The Last Leaf
programme.desc: A small New York apartment was a favorite location for an O. Henry story. Here, just around the corner from the turn of the century, in Greenwich Village, we find two young struggling artists who've become the best of friends only to have one stricken with deadly Pneumonia. And she is convinced that when the last leaf falls from the ivy outside her window, that she will go too.

programme.title: Family First
programme.desc: JP and Vincent, two brothers from a dysfunctional family, get involved in their uncle's drug cartel. Things quickly start spiraling out of control for Vincent, the younger and more unstable of the two.

programme.title: The Last Ones
programme.desc: Following a virus that took the lives of most of the population, John and Micheal have spent their days trying to survive and make sense of their new world. But when they meet the mysterious Karina, who has knowledge of the outside world, their friendship and everything they once knew about the virus and each other will be tested.

programme.title: Observance
programme.desc: In the grip of grief following the death of his young son, his marriage on the rocks and nearing bankruptcy, Parker reluctantly returns to work as a private investigator. Embarking on an unusual assignment to observe a woman from an abandoned apartment, Parker witnesses bizarre happenings surrounding her, unaware that the derelict building that he surveys her from has birthed a dark presence which slowly threatens to consume him.

programme.title: Ligier European Series - Le Castellet, Race 2
programme.desc: La presión sube, rivalidades al máximo en una lucha multiclase hasta el final.

programme.desc: Master carver George Johnson joins George Vondriska in the workshop to share his time-honored carving knowledge and show you how to make your own handcrafted holiday ornament. George demonstrates the intricate art of carving as he brings a wooden Santa-shaped ornament to life. This project makes for a thoughtful gift or a one-of-a-kind adornment for your tree.

programme.title: Fabric First
programme.desc: There are many sources for inspiration when choosing a sewing project. Sometimes we find the perfect pattern or silhouette, and sometimes it's a special occasion we want to sew for, other times we simply love a particular fabric and look for something to make out of a gorgeous cut. But each fabric has characteristics that require different techniques. We chose 3 fabrics today and projects that are unique to the fabric chosen. First, Angela shows her technique for needle felting on silk. Next, Tina Givens introduces us to one of her favorite fabrics -- linen. She has some tips for quilt blocks that tell a unique story. Then, Angela returns for free motion techniques on cotton.

programme.title: Provisional Cast-On, Cable Cast-On & Split Neckline
programme.desc: Since when do knitters use crochet hooks? Find out how to work the provisional cast-on, cable cast-on, and more during the first Novel-T check in!

programme.title: Four Ways to Yarn Over in Pattern & Lace Knitting Demystified
programme.desc: Did you know there is more than one way to do a yarn over? Yup, there are actually four! This week Tracey and Jodi demonstrate all four techniques and talk about when to use each.

programme.title: On the Move
programme.desc: We are on the move, with projects that go along with us, or move themselves! Join host Katie Hacker and make a rockin' roadster that really rolls. Artist Franz Spohn uses a little string to add animation to his art and blogger Jenny Barnett Rohrs make a wreath with colorful felt pinwheels. Use the Family Craft Box and recycled denim to make a car track. Decorate your room with an eye-catching string art project that uses color to create the feeling of movement.

programme.title: Too Nice to Stay Inside
programme.desc: Let's head outside for some fun. Jenny Barnett-Rohrs makes colorful hand grips for your bike. Katie Hacker has some fun with friendly bugs. Franz Spohn has sidewalk art tips and Katie makes special discovery eggs.

programme.title: Close It Up
programme.desc: Securely finish your jewelry with flair. Jewelry designer and blogger Molly Schaller returns with techniques using crimps and other findings to secure closures. In the Beading Lesson, Katie makes personalized bangles from 16-gauge wire and crystals that tell your story.

programme.title: Learn How to Viking Knit
programme.desc: Stephanie Eddy shares some of her secrets about Viking knitting -- making a bracelet and ways to add beads to Viking knit. Katie has some special tips for making stretchy bracelets more durable in her Beading Lesson.

programme.title: Episode 12: Paint and Ink
programme.desc: This episode features paint and ink techniques. First, Dina Wakley uses paint and ink to create a vibrant watercolor background for her page layout. Julie interviews Joe Rotella about his glass etching project. Then, Kathy Cano Murillo tie dyes fabric to use as a background for her page layout. Last, Julie creates a tie dye look with a watercolor technique.

Artist and teacher Cat Kerr molds shining eyes to use in lots of different projects. Learn a new tip from Jane Dunnewold.

Using her engineering background, quilt designer Yvonne Fuchs creates beautiful quilts with quarter square triangles.

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.title: Its In Our Nature
programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

programme.title: Vettai
programme.desc: "They are part of a special task force assembled to tackle cases pertaining to the Indian community and Indian immigrants. The unit is not widely publicized and their work is kept under wraps. Spearheaded by Chief Dayanidhi, the team consists of three teams and an assigned criminologist. Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?"

programme.title: Constantine and the Cross 1961
programme.desc: In Constantine and the Cross, the sweeping saga of Rome’s first Christian emperor comes to life. Cornel Wilde stars as Constantine, the warrior who rises from soldier to ruler while the empire is torn by conflict and faith. Guided by a vision of the cross, he embraces a new destiny, leading his legions into battle and laying the foundation for a transformed world. With epic battles, palace intrigue, and timeless themes of belief and power, this historical drama tells the inspiring story of a man who changed history forever.

programme.title: The Miracle on 34th St 1955
programme.desc: In The Miracle on 34th Street, a kindly old man hired to play Santa Claus at Macy’s insists that he is the real Kris Kringle. As his warmth and generosity touch everyone around him, skeptics take him to court to prove his claim. Blending holiday charm, heartfelt performances, and a timeless message about faith and belief, this television adaptation of the classic story reminds audiences that sometimes the greatest miracles are the ones we choose to believe in.

programme.title: Rudolf the Rednosed Reindeer 1948
programme.desc: In Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, the beloved Christmas song comes to life in an enchanting animated short. When a young reindeer is mocked for his glowing red nose, he fears he’ll never find his place—until a foggy Christmas Eve when Santa calls on Rudolph to guide his sleigh. With charming animation, festive music, and a timeless message about courage and acceptance, this holiday classic has warmed hearts for generations.

programme.title: Esther and the King 1960
programme.desc: In Esther and the King, the timeless biblical story unfolds in a lavish tale of courage, love, and destiny. When King Ahasuerus of Persia (Richard Egan) seeks a new queen, the beautiful and humble Esther (Joan Collins) is chosen, unaware that her faith will soon be tested. As a deadly plot threatens her people, Esther must summon her strength to risk everything and protect them. With grandeur, passion, and epic spectacle, this historical drama brings to life one of the Bible’s most inspiring heroines.

programme.title: The Jack Benny Christmas Show 1961
programme.desc: In The Jack Benny Christmas Show, holiday cheer meets classic comedy as Jack Benny brings his trademark wit to a festive television special. Joined by his regular cast and surprise guests, Benny’s dry humor and perfectly timed gags light up the season with laughter. Blending sketches, music, and holiday spirit, this variety show captures the warmth and fun of Christmas in true Jack Benny style.

programme.title: Saul and David 1964
programme.desc: In Saul and David, the epic struggle of faith, jealousy, and destiny unfolds on the grand scale of biblical history. When humble shepherd David rises to fame after defeating Goliath, he becomes a loyal servant to King Saul. But as David’s popularity grows, Saul’s envy turns to fury, sparking a tragic conflict between king and chosen heir. With sweeping battles, powerful drama, and timeless themes of loyalty and betrayal, this historical epic brings one of the Bible’s most gripping stories to life.

programme.title: A Christmas Without Snow 1980
programme.desc: In A Christmas Without Snow, Michael Learned stars as a recently divorced woman who moves to San Francisco to rebuild her life. Joining the choir of a struggling church, she finds friendship, strength, and a new sense of purpose under the guidance of the stern but inspiring choirmaster (John Houseman). As the group prepares for a performance of Handel’s Messiah, their shared struggles and triumphs bring them closer together, revealing the true meaning of hope and community during the holiday season. Heartfelt and uplifting, this made-for-TV classic shines with warmth and faith.

programme.title: The Littlest Angel 1969
programme.desc: In The Littlest Angel, the beloved holiday story comes to life in a touching musical special. Jerry Skinner stars as a small boy who enters heaven but struggles to fit in among the angels. Longing for the simple joys of his earthly life, he offers a humble gift that becomes the most treasured of all. With heartfelt songs, tender performances, and a timeless message of love and faith, this family favorite captures the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: The Big 22 Rifle for Christmas 1952
programme.desc: In The Big 22 Rifle for Christmas, a heartwarming holiday drama turns tragic when a boy’s dream gift becomes the center of an unexpected accident. As a small-town community reels, the story explores themes of responsibility, forgiveness, and the true meaning of Christmas. Tenderly told and emotionally powerful, this short film offers a timeless reminder of the importance of love, understanding, and family during the holiday season.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood: The Christmas Goose 1957
programme.desc: In The Adventures of Robin Hood: The Christmas Goose, Richard Greene dons the green cloak once more in this holiday-themed tale of merriment and mischief. When greedy lords try to tax the people of Sherwood into hunger during the Christmas season, Robin Hood and his Merry Men hatch a clever plan involving a prize goose to bring cheer back to the poor. With daring adventure, festive spirit, and a touch of Yuletide humor, this family-friendly special blends classic Robin Hood heroics with holiday warmth.

programme.title: The Miracle on 34th St 1955
programme.desc: In The Miracle on 34th Street, a kindly old man hired to play Santa Claus at Macy’s insists that he is the real Kris Kringle. As his warmth and generosity touch everyone around him, skeptics take him to court to prove his claim. Blending holiday charm, heartfelt performances, and a timeless message about faith and belief, this television adaptation of the classic story reminds audiences that sometimes the greatest miracles are the ones we choose to believe in.

programme.title: Santa Claus 1959
programme.desc: In Santa Claus, the holiday takes a surreal and magical turn in this colorful fantasy from Mexico. As Christmas Eve approaches, Santa battles the schemes of a mischievous demon sent by the Devil to ruin the season for children everywhere. With the help of Merlin the wizard, a loyal band of helpers, and his magical workshop in the sky, Santa must outwit evil and deliver joy to the world. Whimsical, strange, and utterly unique, this cult holiday classic blends wonder, morality, and a touch of the bizarre into a Christmas tale like no other.

programme.title: A Christmas Without Snow 1980
programme.desc: In A Christmas Without Snow, Michael Learned stars as a recently divorced woman who moves to San Francisco to rebuild her life. Joining the choir of a struggling church, she finds friendship, strength, and a new sense of purpose under the guidance of the stern but inspiring choirmaster (John Houseman). As the group prepares for a performance of Handel’s Messiah, their shared struggles and triumphs bring them closer together, revealing the true meaning of hope and community during the holiday season. Heartfelt and uplifting, this made-for-TV classic shines with warmth and faith.

programme.title: The Great Rupert 1950
programme.desc: In The Great Rupert, holiday magic comes in the form of an unexpected hero—a clever little squirrel! When a down-on-their-luck vaudeville family moves into a new home, they discover that Rupert, a trained squirrel, has a knack for showering them with good fortune. With Jimmy Durante adding warmth and humor, this heartwarming comedy blends laughter, music, and a touch of Christmas wonder into a charming tale of hope, luck, and the unexpected ways happiness finds us.

programme.title: Santa Claus Conquers the Martians 1964
programme.desc: In Santa Claus Conquers the Martians, holiday cheer goes interplanetary when Martians, desperate to bring joy to their children, kidnap Santa and whisk him away to the Red Planet. With the help of two Earth kids and his boundless Christmas spirit, Santa turns the tables on his captors and spreads laughter across the galaxy. Campy, colorful, and brimming with 1960s sci-fi charm, this cult favorite delivers a cosmic dose of yuletide fun.

programme.title: Howdy Doody Christmas 1951
programme.desc: In Howdy Doody Christmas, America’s favorite puppet and his pals from Doodyville celebrate the season with songs, laughter, and holiday cheer. As Howdy, Buffalo Bob, Clarabell, and the gang prepare for Christmas, they share festive stories and timeless lessons about friendship and giving. Filled with warmth, whimsy, and nostalgic charm, this holiday special brings the magic of the beloved children’s show to the spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol 1951
programme.desc: In A Christmas Carol, Alastair Sim delivers a definitive performance as Ebenezer Scrooge, the miser whose icy heart is thawed by a haunting Christmas Eve journey. Visited by the ghost of Jacob Marley and the three Spirits of Christmas, Scrooge is forced to confront his past, witness the struggles of the present, and glimpse the bleak future awaiting him if he does not change. With atmospheric direction, powerful performances, and a timeless message of redemption, this beloved adaptation brings Charles Dickens’ classic tale to life in unforgettable fashion.

programme.title: Cemetery Stories
programme.desc: On Halloween a couple, both of which are clairvoyants, drive to a cemetery. They go for fun to pick up vibrations from the tombstones of the deceased. As they pick up vibrations they have visions of how the person died. Each vibration and vision seems to get darker and darker. In the midst of all of this, they are being stalked by a dark shadowy figure. What starts out as some Halloween fun quickly turns to terror...

programme.title: Groupie
programme.desc: When a mysterious groupie joins legendary cursed band, "The Dark Knights", a series of unexplained murders derails their comeback tour...

programme.title: Rise of the Mummy
programme.desc: A group of archaeology students awaken an ancient mummy. After being trapped in a time loop, the only way they can escape, is to defeat the mummy. As the body count rises, it seems the Mummy has to collect the souls of those who woke him to be able to walk the earth - for good...

programme.title: My Bloody Birthday
programme.desc: After a terrible trauma on her birthday, Emma chooses not to celebrate it again. But when she turns 21, a friend of her breaks the ritual with a surprise party, unaware of awakening horrors, which for years have been waiting in the darkness...

programme.title: Slasher.com
programme.desc: After meeting online, Jack and Kristy go on a weekend getaway to the woodlands of rural Missouri. While discovering each other, they soon learn of the terrorizing horrors that the forest has in store...

programme.title: The Fear
programme.desc: The Bloody Hand tells the story of a student named Hien who studies in Little Saigon. Her peaceful life completely changes when the young girl rents a room that was once owned by Lien the daughter of the landlord, who was kidnapped, raped and killed by five criminals, who were never caught...

programme.title: The Devil's Fairground
programme.desc: Starring Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson and John Charles Dickson. The Stars of two competing and colliding paranormal television shows converge on an abandoned haunted amusement park which ends up being the epicenter to hell. They are now all trapped - in an all out war against pure evil...

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: A young Nurse is assigned to look after a patient in a remote location in the English countryside. As the night continues she finds herself terrorized by an unseen force that is connected with her patient...

programme.title: Ouija Hosts
programme.desc: Presenters of paranormal TV show "Ghost Hosts" are filming in an abandoned haunted building as part of a Halloween special. The stories surrounding the horrifying ghosts of the mansion are about to become reality...

programme.title: The Devil's Forest
programme.desc: Rachel and her team of film makers travel to Transylvania, Romania, to document the paranormal phenomena within Hoia-Baciu Forest...

programme.title: Ghost Boat
programme.desc: Trapped aboard the family yacht, Samantha lives out her personal Hell, night after night, answering to the cruel and painful demands of the ship's alarm system. Taking a journey into the depths of depravity, she wakes each morning to the disfiguring scars left by the previous night's horror and searches for the answer to a missing memory: 'Could I have killed my family... Or did Hell get it wrong?

programme.title: H.P. Lovecraft's Monster Portal
programme.desc: A cult is about to waken H.P. Lovecraft's most feared creature...

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Rose awakes in an unknown house following a serious car accident with memory loss and no ability to walk. Her Mother and boyfriend are there to help her. Rose wants to piece together her life before the accident. All is not what it seems...

programme.title: Island of the Dolls
programme.desc: A group of people go to the legendary Island of the Dolls to learn the deadly truth...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: Jack y Jill: Las Colinas del Infierno
programme.desc: Tras buscar a su hija desaparecida, una dama y su grupo de búsqueda descubren la leyenda que se esconde tras la pareja asesina de Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Ouija: Reunión Mortal
programme.desc: Sucesos extraños les ocurren a unos amigos antes de una fiesta de cumpleaños en un gran almacén. Dos de ellos encuentran un viejo tablero de espiritismo y deciden contactar con los antiguos inquilinos de la víctima fallecida...

programme.title: El Resurgir de la Momia
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de arqueología despierta a una momia ancestral. Tras quedar atrapados en un bucle temporal, la única forma de escapar es derrotarla. A medida que aumenta el número de cadáveres, parece que la Momia debe recolectar las almas de quienes la despertaron para poder caminar sobre la tierra, para siempre...

programme.title: Jack y Jill 3
programme.desc: 10 años después de los últimos asesinatos atroces en la colina, Jack y Jill están de regreso para masacrar al elenco y al equipo de un programa de Internet en vivo que busca descubrir los secretos de la leyenda...

programme.title: El Demonio Interior
programme.desc: Años después de salir de la cárcel, Sam Parsons intenta rehacer su vida con su mujer Courtney y su hija Harper. Trabaja duro para mantener a su familia y permitirse una bonita casa en su tranquilo barrio de las afueras. Cuando empiezan a ocurrir sucesos sobrenaturales en la casa, Sam teme por la seguridad de su mujer y su hija. Cuando los sucesos se convierten en ataques, Sam contrata a Corbin Carlysle y a su equipo de cazafantasmas conocido como «The Ghost Killers», para que le ayuden a luchar contra la entidad oscura que acecha en las sombras de su casa. Cuando las cosas empiezan a complicarse y queda claro que esta entidad es mucho más peligrosa que el típico fantasma, surgen complicaciones cuando Corbin y su equipo se centran más en la fama y la fortuna. Para ganar esta lucha Sam debe luchar contra sus propios demonios interiores y volver a su violento pasado. Para salvar a sus seres queridos, un Demonio debe enfrentarse a un Demonio.

programme.title: Ahora Se Mueren
programme.desc: Una guerra entre narcos estalla tras un encuentro casual en una calle de Michoacan.

programme.title: Alas De La Muerte
programme.desc: Drama y accion que revela hasta donde llegan los carteles para conseguir lo que quieren.

programme.title: Alas De La Muerte 2
programme.desc: Una mujer busca venganza tras la muerte de su esposo y lucha por rescatar a su hijo del narco.

programme.title: Amargo Licor
programme.desc: Un hombre casado pierde a su familia debido a las devastadoras consecuencias del alcoholismo.

programme.title: Ambicion Maldita
programme.desc: Una joven empieza a trabajar como empleada doméstica en la casa de un hombre rico y exitoso.

programme.title: Amor Interes y Muerte
programme.desc: Por ambicion, padres obligan a su hija a casarse con un hombre mayor, pero todo sale mal.

programme.title: Aprendiendo a Matar
programme.desc: Tras un tiroteo, Pedro encuentra dinero y lo esconde, manteniendo el secreto incluso de su esposa.

programme.title: Apuesta con la Muerte
programme.desc: Valente pacta con la muerte para revivir a su hermano, sin prever las terribles consecuencias.

programme.title: Apuesta con la Muerte 2
programme.desc: Tras ser liberado, Carrillo lucha por recuperar el cartel, desatando una guerra sin límites.

programme.title: Arareko Amor y Odio
programme.desc: Lo que los padres no vivieron, sus hijos lo intentan, pero la envidia trae odio y muerte en Creel.

programme.title: Asalto Equivocado
programme.desc: Sergio Campa, exconvicto, intenta rehacer su vida pero es acusado de un asalto a mano armada.

programme.title: Caceria de Asesinos
programme.desc: El Cadete y su hijo quedan atrapados en un fuego cruzado en el centro comercial, cambiando sus vidas.

programme.title: Cabron y Vago 2
programme.desc: Felix y el Marrano enfrentan problemas y romance mientras recogen una carga valiosa en Michoacan.

programme.title: El Tercer Deseo
programme.desc: Eugenio, un corredor de bienes raíces despierta en una esquina de la ciudad con una descomunal borrachera y descubre cerca una desportillada tetera de metal. La toma y manosea a ver si es de plata y, de pronto, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le sugiere formule tres deseos. El genio desaparece sin dar oportunidad al tercer deseo. Mas tarde, descubre que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada. La vida de Eugenio se complica, solo anhela reencontrar la tetera abandonada y pedir el tercer deseo.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento. Una historia no previsible que juega al despiste, por lo que, hay que esperar hasta el final para saber lo que está pasando la protagonista.

programme.title: ¡Ni Te Me Acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo. Y Llega la cuarentena y se queda le pilla en el Hotel Balneario de Ariño haciendo frente a la paranoia general, el acoso de las fuerzas del orden, las videollamadas de su novia, su madre y del conspiranoico Javi... Todos nos aburrimos mucho en el primer confinamiento. Juan no.

programme.title: El Secuestro
programme.desc: Un joven con talento en la música sueña con ser un gran artista hasta que conoce al hijo de un poderoso narcotraficante colombiano quién promete ayudarlo a cambio de que trabaje para ellos. El joven no se imagina en que mundo se está metiendo. La fama le costará lo que más ama.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: 4 Metros
programme.desc: 4 METROS relata, en tono de comedia romántica, la historia de un hombre entrando en la crisis de los 40. Joaquín tiene un zumbido en los oídos y poco sabe de sí mismo. Se ha dejado llevar sin intervenir demasiado en sus deseos. No escucha su voz interior. Su vida afectiva y laboral no tienen rumbo. El zumbido quizá sea la expresión, no asumida ni entendida todavía, de un ruido metafórico de la vida gritándole por dónde ir. Su novia tiene 20 años menos, aparece la presión social y familiar sobre la paternidad, sentirse útil, la vocación, el trabajo y cómo ser feliz. Hasta que otra mujer irrumpe y todo parece acomodarse. Pero siempre el orden debe ser interno. Así, como si el destino tomara la palabra, su vida cambiará 4 metros abajo del agua, donde aparece un sendero para encontrar la identidad.

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0
programme.desc: Mientras el líder de los delincuentes de la ciudad, Jack se reúne con el demonio Lilly alias Abal en un antro/table para matar y tomar las almas de sus víctimas. El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: Baile Peligroso
programme.desc: Miluska es una cantante, que se gana la vida haciendo shows musicales para un hotel turístico en el sur de Perú. Durante las presentaciones conoce una variedad de empresarios de todo nivel, entre ellos está Don Mauro, un señor respetable, que admira mucho a Miluska, Carlos Reyes, un traficante de mujeres que se hace pasar por empresario. Al ser cliente frecuente del hotel se gana cierta confianza con las chicas, un día le ofrece a Miluska hacer un show para su hotel en otra provincia, pero no sabían que caerían en una trampa difícil de escapar.

programme.title: Codón Es Una Máquina
programme.desc: Dos amigos se reúnen para planear la creación de una película con un equipo de producción filmando el proceso, dos cuarentones con problemitas están muy decididos a hacer la famosa película de la que llevan años hablando. Se vienen tan arriba que hasta ya graban el making of... y hasta están haciendo un casting, aunque no tienen ni guión ni puñetera idea de lo que van a rodar. Y lo peor: no sospechan que están en las manos de un loco peligroso.

programme.title: El Mariachi Gringo
programme.desc: Comedia romántica sobre un joven de la América profunda que -tras tener como improvisado maestro de guitarra a un emigrante- viaja a México huyendo de su vida tediosa y de su familia, para ejercitarse como mariachi.

programme.title: Canon: Fidelidad al Límite
programme.desc: Mariana de 35 años, es una arquitecta que trabaja y es socia de un importante despacho de arquitectos, está casada con Julián de 40 años, quien es corresponsal de guerra. Está enamorados, felices, con relación sexual cotidiana. Son padre de dos hijos de 14 y 17 año. En el juego sexual, Julián menciona que no le importaría la infidelidad a condición de estar enterado del hecho con detalles.

programme.title: Bendita Calamidad
programme.desc: Los hermanos Fayos, Anselmo y Ricardo, están con el agua al cuello. Su bar no funciona, el Ayuntamiento lo clausura y se ha agotado el dinero que, para ir tirando, solicitaron a unos prestamistas que no se andan con contemplaciones a la hora de cobrar. Piden consejo a un abogado poco amigo de la ley, Antonio Orestes, que les sugiere una vía rápida para acabar con sus problemas: El secuestro exprés de un constructor de Tarazona.

programme.title: Aerosol
programme.desc: El líder de una banda mexicana mata a un oponente en la guerra de pandillas en los 80's, por lo que huye a la ciudad de Los Ángeles, California. Dieciocho años después regresa al barrio sin un objetivo definido, sólo para encontrar a su hermano menor, involucrado en las pandillas de hoy. El crimen organizado utiliza niños para distribuir droga en los barrios. En combatir la corrupción y el crimen que hay en el barrio, Nuk encuentra un significado para su retorno y un camino para redimir las muertes que causó

programme.title: Catemaco: Magia y Misterio
programme.desc: Una familia normal va de vacaciones a Catemaco, Michoacan un pueblo famoso y pintoresco en Mexico. Todo marcha bien hasta que son atacados por criminales, el padre sobrevive, y con ayuda del brujo mayor del pueblo cobra venganza.

programme.title: Entre Brujas y Nahuales
programme.desc: En la ciudad de Tulancingo Hidalgo, Acatlán y San Dionicio la gente anda muy asustada, pues se rumora que están ocurriendo sucesos fuera de lo normal, tal como desaparición de niños de quienes se han encontrado cuerpos sin sangre, dicen que son las brujas, porque han visto bolas de fuego que aparecen y desaparecen, pero nadie sabe la verdad lo que esta pasando y existe mucho miedo en la población de la región.

programme.title: El Juego del Sexo
programme.desc: Un alienígena cambiante procedente del espacio exterior causa estragos en un pequeño pueblo rural del suroeste de Estados Unidos, cerca del legendario Área 51 de fama ovni. Estos extraterrestres son una raza devoradora de cerebros a quienes les encanta decapitar y comerse a los humanos. Están entre nosotros y lo han estado durante millones de años.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: El Sonido de los Tulipanes
programme.desc: En Buenos Aires durante la crisis del 2001, Marcelo un escritor devenido en periodista, debe volver sobre los últimos pasos de su padre Tonio un consagrado intelectual de quien se encuentra profundamente distanciado cuando muere en condiciones extrañas.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento.

programme.title: 48 Horas de Terror
programme.desc: Mateo un escritor citadino adquiere una casa de campo en donde planea vivir con su esposa y escribir en la tranquilidad del campo, pero no tomo en cuenta las trágicas noticias de los acontecimientos de canibalismo que ocurrieron a manos de sus vecinos quienes solo buscan sacias su hambre.

programme.title: The Juniors y La Formula Imperial
programme.desc: Narra las vidas de 7 adolescentes millonarios que se aventuran a planificar una revolución social, generada por vídeo-escándalos y experimentos médicos, con el objetivo de generar un cambio en la ideología mundial, el conflicto entre las clases sociales y el enfrentamiento con sus muchachas de servicio doméstico.

programme.title: Mi Pequeña Pesadilla
programme.desc: Después de la terrible experiencia y la pérdida de sus amigos, Heather se ve obligada a regresar al Hotel Fear donde Travis se prepara para sus próximas víctimas.

programme.title: Morirse En Domingo
programme.desc: Julio Salas muere tras una larga enfermedad, pero es domingo y su familia por dificultades económicas se ve forzada a contratar los servicios de una modesta agencia funeraria.

programme.title: Hienas
programme.desc: Luis ha metido la pata... hasta el fondo. Pero Pepe está ahí para ayudarlo... a caer. Ninguno de los dos tenía idea del grandísimo lío en el que andaban metidos ya desde hacía tiempo. Una liada de cojones.

programme.title: "Not Now" Is Not "No"
programme.desc: Sometimes, when you’ve been waiting a long time on something, God isn’t saying, “no,” He’s going slow to teach you something. This sermon will help you feel encouraged that just because it’s not happening on your schedule, doesn’t mean it’s not happening on God’s.

programme.title: Knocking Through The No
programme.desc: In “Knocking Through The No,” Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that the doors of tomorrow’s opportunities swing on the hinges of today’s obedience.

programme.title: God Prompts
programme.desc: We often ask God to do what we want, but faith starts with doing what He says. When you trust God as your good Father and follow His prompting, even small steps can unlock something big.

programme.title: Concealed But Not Canceled
programme.desc: As we celebrate our 18-year anniversary, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us in “Concealed But Not Canceled” that God can turn our greatest weakness into His greatest weapon.

programme.title: Rags To Righteous
programme.desc: There’s more God wants to do through you. In “Rags to Righteous!” Pastor Steven Furtick explains that God has a plan for every pit stop on the way to your purpose.

programme.title: The God Of After
programme.desc: It’s time to get ready. In “The God Of After,” Pastor Steven Furtick reveals that the attack you’re facing is proof of the purpose on your life.

programme.title: Don't Tap Out Tap In
programme.desc: What are you really fighting? In “Don’t Tap Out Tap In,” Pastor Steven Furtick reveals that God is waging war with what’s coming against you — because the fruit is coming!

programme.title: The Prayer That Repairs
programme.desc: Don’t be so confused about the noise around you that you can’t hear the God who made you. When you’re faced with a struggle you didn’t see coming, remember that Jesus is already praying for you, and His prayer is stronger than any attack.

programme.title: Move It To The Middle
programme.desc: Stressed, insecure, and stuck — that’s how Moses felt, too. But that wasn’t the end of his story, and it’s not yours, either. It’s just the middle. There’s hope past this chapter, and it’s found by shifting your focus back to God.

programme.title: A Recipe For Resentment
programme.desc: If you’ve been feeling pulled in every direction, it might be time to pivot. God isn’t asking you to do everything — He’s asking you to stay close to Him

programme.title: The Lord Will Lighten Your Load
programme.desc: When you’ve been hurt, it can be hard to keep hoping. But God wants to lift the weight you’ve been carrying today. Learn from the life of Israel (Jacob, Jacob), how God will give you a strategy to unburden your heart and move forward.

programme.title: When God Gets Ready
programme.desc: People label, but God names. You don’t have to chase identity or earn worth, because you’ve always been called, loved, and set apart for something more.

programme.title: When God Says Let Go
programme.desc: Is your faith being tested? If you’ve been waiting on the details of what God has next, remember that God doesn’t give a test without a lesson first, so if He’s calling you to let go of something, you can trust He’s already provided you with what you’ll need to take that step.

programme.title: All Those Times You Didn’t See
programme.desc: The efforts you make when no one’s watching are the ones God uses to shape you. Just because you don't see the outcome yet doesn’t mean He’s ignoring you; He's positioning you. Keep showing up while you wait.

programme.title: Page Turner
programme.desc: God is just getting started. Join Pastor Steven Furtick in the first installment of his new series, “Ghost Writer,” as he explains that the messiness in our lives could be the birthplace of a story that’s about to unfold for God’s glory.

programme.title: Plot Hole
programme.desc: In “Plot Hole,” Pastor Steven Furtick continues his sermon series, “Ghost Writer,” and teaches us how to lean on the Holy Spirit to fill in the gaps when we don’t know all the answers.

programme.title: Source Material
programme.desc: In “Source Material,” we’re taught that walking in our assignment requires us to allow the Holy Spirit to lead us.

programme.title: Places Everyone!
programme.desc: Stand there and see what God can do. In “Places Everyone!,” Pastor Steven shows us that God meets us on our path so we can receive restoration in unexpected places.

programme.title: Cutting Room
programme.desc: In “Cutting Room,” Pastor Steven Furtick reminds us that our situation might be bigger than us, but it’s not bigger than our God.

programme.title: OFF MENU
programme.desc: In “OFF MENU,” Pastor Steven Furtick reminds us that even though we might not feel ready for this season of our lives, God has already prepared us for the exact assignment that we are designed to accomplish.

programme.title: Forward Not Finished
programme.desc: In “Forward Not Finished,” Pastor Steven Furtick reminds us that God is still writing our story — so don’t give up believing Him for more.

programme.title: Focus Your Faith
programme.desc: In “Focus Your Faith,” Pastor Steven Furtick shows us how the power of faith can transform our perspective.

programme.title: Special Forces (Ep2)
programme.desc: Produced with the full cooperation of the Federal Bureau of Investigation, The FBI Files takes viewers behind-the-scenes of major crime investigations and enters what, until now, has been the world's least accessible crime lab. Through dramatic reenactments and interviews with agents and scientists’ viewers witness the actual process of some of the FBI's most famous investigations. And as the agents gather seemingly unremarkable clues, they transform them into hard evidence - the kind of evidence that brings a criminal to justice

programme.title: The FBI Files (Ep41)
programme.desc: Actual true crimes between well-known people and less-known too with dramatic reenactment and interviews with forensic scientists who work on the investigations.

programme.title: The FBI Files (Ep41)
programme.desc: Actual true crimes between well-known people and less-known too with dramatic reenactment and interviews with forensic scientists who work on the investigations.

programme.title: The New Detectives (Ep41)

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 04, Ep. 2
programme.desc: Explore a vibrant world of international pop-dance and club music, where melodic hooks meet energetic electronic production. From uplifting anthems to rhythmic crossover cuts, this episode moves across styles with a global feel—mixing radio-friendly choruses with dancefloor punch and colorful genre variety.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 01, Ep. 1
programme.desc: Dive into a high-energy mix of club-ready electronic, dance, and crossover tracks paired with exclusive artist moments and interviews. This episode blends peak-time grooves, melodic dance anthems, and bass-driven cuts with behind-the-scenes conversations, freestyle performances, and nightlife visuals captured in Las Vegas. A fast-moving, music-first experience that sets the tone for DJ Central TV’s signature sound, culture, and late-night atmosphere.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 02, Ep. 3
programme.desc: Step into a club-focused blend of electro, house, hardstyle, and vocal dance, framed by turntablist flair and Zouk-influenced pop. With mostly English-language vocals and a strong European club feel, the playlist moves from heavy bass and quirky experimental cuts to catchy hooks and radio-ready choruses. This session links underground textures with accessible, sing-along moments on the dancefloor.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 01, Ep. 13
programme.desc: Dive into a grand finale of high-impact trance, progressive anthems, emotional vocals, and driving club rhythms. This episode captures the spirit of a festival closing set—uplifting, powerful, and filled with the defining sounds that shaped the season.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 02, Ep. 2
programme.desc: Explore a genre-hopping ride from scratch-driven electro and classic house to hardstyle, vocal trance, and modern pop-dance. Primarily English-language tracks are complemented by European club influences and festival-ready drops, with iconic moments from Frankie Knuckles and big-room anthems sitting beside fresh crossover hits. It’s a celebration of dance culture past and present, blending nostalgia, energy, and hands-in-the-air emotion.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 06, Ep. 10
programme.desc: A darker, more club-underground leaning session with sharp rhythmic focus and strong bass textures. Expect heavy energy, edgy transitions, and a confident flow that keeps things intense while still feeling polished and controlled.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 07, Ep. 1
programme.desc: A high-voltage season launch built around big bass pressure, club-ready hooks, and fast transitions. The episode moves between heavy electronic moments and punchy crossover cuts, keeping the pace sharp and the energy consistently peak-time.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 02, Ep. 13
programme.desc: Dive into a stylish mix of electro-pop, indie dance, underground house, and big-room festival sounds to close out the run. Mostly English-language vocals are paired with French-touch influences, dark cinematic textures, and uplifting trance and EDM highlights. From fashion-forward club tracks to feel-good dance-floor weapons, this session wraps everything into a confident, late-night finale.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 05, Ep. 9
programme.desc: Step into a fast-moving mix built on bass pressure, club energy, and global flavours, with quick switches that keep listeners locked in. Expect heavy electronic moments, rap-driven heat, and dancefloor hooks that hit clean and hard.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 04, Ep. 6
programme.desc: Step into a polished mix of vocal dance, melodic trance, and crossover pop cuts, blending emotional hooks with high-energy club movement. The episode balances uplifting anthem moments with smooth groove sections—delivering a versatile electronic set that shifts between big-room energy and radio-ready shine.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 01, Ep. 07
programme.desc: Dive into a powerful combination of euphoric trance, Afro-dance grooves, K-Pop favourites, and cutting-edge electro. With uplifting melodies and global influences, this episode captures the pulse of club culture and the spirit of dance music’s ever-expanding universe.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 02, Ep. 8
programme.desc: Explore a versatile blend of dark electro, pop-dance, R&B-influenced vocal tracks, and indie-leaning electronica. Predominantly English-language songs mix club-ready beats with live-band sensibilities, turntablist textures, and soulful hooks. From underground-coloured grooves to catchy choruses, this lineup bridges alternative and mainstream worlds on the dancefloor.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 02, Ep. 12
programme.desc: Step into a more left-field corner of the dance universe, where indie electro, techno-leaning tracks, and underground house grooves rub shoulders with festival-friendly anthems. Primarily English-language songs move between moody, art-driven productions and crowd-pleasing bangers, with chunky bass, hypnotic rhythms, and bold, character-rich vocals. It’s an adventurous blend for listeners who love both edge and impact.

programme.title: DJ Central TV - Season 06, Ep. 1
programme.desc: A punchy season opener built for peak-time energy—where hard electronic pressure meets bass-heavy intensity and confident crossover moments. Expect fast switches, big drops, and a steady climb that sets a bold, modern tone right from the start.

programme.desc: It is Tokunbo Martins’s 40th birthday, and against his will, his wife, Tare Martins, throws him a surprise party. But he is unhappy about this and worried about something else. He wants to quit his job as a Bank Manager to follow his dream of being a livestock farmer

programme.title: Squatterz S6 The Godfather
programme.desc: Voke invited Bob the magician to a house party. Bob performed some magic and Papa didn't believe him until he performed another magic. Papa decided to be a magician he told Bob to teach him how to do magic. Papa performed a magic on Voke, which turned him into a rabbit. He performed the magic again but Voke didn't come as him.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 La Confiance
programme.desc: Tokunbo gets a golden opportunity to supply eggs to Cote d’Ivoire, and language would be a huge barrier. Tare suggests he get a French tutor. When she saw who the tutor turned out to be, she became jealous and would not allow it to continue.

programme.title: Squatterz S3 Fool At Forty
programme.desc: Papa gets into an argument with his girlfriend over marriage, and this leads to his worst nightmare

programme.title: Squatterz S3 The Proposal
programme.desc: Papa became tired of the constant pressure from his mum about getting married and decided to take the bull by the horns. Wedding bells ringing soon or not?

programme.title: B.O.A.F S3 Homecation
programme.desc: Their son Obafemi, who is already used to yearly vacation he did not know was sponsored by the bank, his father’s former place of work started throwing a tantrum because his parents told him they would not be traveling this year. To cheer him up, they decided to bring vacation home.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S1 Breaking News
programme.desc: Justice Tunde Abiola fell in love with his nurse Uche, and decided to marry her. He introduces her to his children, who were not going to have any of it as they devise schemes to destroy the union.

programme.title: Squatterz S2 Papa The Player
programme.desc: Buchi and Esiri dare Papa to use his dating skills to get a babe to prove he is still in the game and not an old cargo. Papa, in turn, snatches all their girlfriends and teaches them a good lesson.

programme.title: Squatterz S4 Interrogation 101
programme.desc: The apartment got burnt and Sege decides to put them in another apartment so they won’t run away, at least until they pay for the old apartment. This leads to an insurance company coming to investigate and the beginning of another journey for them with Raymond, Buchi’s brother but without Buchi

programme.title: B.O.A.F S4 Memories
programme.desc: The family walks down the memory lane to the things that had happened in the past

programme.title: Squatterz S6 Lord Of The Ring
programme.desc: Chinwe continues to throw her tantrum. She put Aliyah's things out of the room and she continued to say Voke must break up with Aliyah. At the end, a man came in to propose to Chinwe.

programme.title: B.O.A.F S2 Am Getting Jealous
programme.desc: Justice Babatunde's millionaire friend David Jones, came to visit him. He wanted to do an event, Justice Babatunde mentioned to him that his daughter, Sade, is an event planner. He took Sade out and she got the best treatment of her life. She came home and started explaining everything to her boyfriend Prince, only for the boy to be very upset. Prince became jealous till he was rude to Mr. David Jones, well, the truth came out that he was genuinely buy things for Sade without any hidden intentions.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 1 - Icons of Tryon
programme.desc: The FEI disciplines - Jumping, Dressage, Para-Dressage, Eventing, Driving, Endurance, Vaulting and Reining have been coming together since 1990. In this special edition of FEI Icons, we go back to September 2018 when the USA hosted the 8th FEI World Equestrian Games at the Tryon International Equestrian Centre, in North Carolina.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 2 - Horses of History
programme.desc: We can only be as good as the horse we are riding. The rider and the horse need to feel a connection, a sort of partnership for both to be near a perfect level. Then, incredible things happen. In this special episode we relive the biggest moments of some of the greatest horses in the history of Jumping, Dressage and Eventing.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour Madrid Copa del Rey - Highlights

programme.title: Maya Gabeira - Return to Nazaré
programme.desc: After a horrible crash in Nazaré that almost took her life, big wave surfer Maya Gabeira fights to overcome physical and mental obstacles and return to surf the giant waves again.Maya Gabeira, the Brazilian surfer that was close to death in 2013 in Nazaré due to big waves. She had to be rescued by lifeguards who struggled to get her out of waves that didn’t stop coming. After recovering physically and emotionally of the shock, she's ready to return to Nazaré to overcome the same obstacles that almost took her life years ago.Her determination is undeniable, as is the danger of tempting fate twice. However, once in Nazaré, will she have the strength needed to surf deathly waves?Follow her inspiring story in Maya Gabeira – Return to Nazaré.

programme.title: Guadeloupe: Caribbean Blues
programme.desc: A visit to Guadeloupe is like visiting all corners of our world’s beauty. Looking to the left you can catch a breeze that swifts a kite surfer in the air, and to the right a gust of smoke from the Soufriere’s volcanic top. Everything in between is a perfectly balanced mixture of colour, tradition, and a lifestyle to die for.Guadeloupe: Caribbean Blues takes us on a trip to this dreamy destination. Rhythm and music go hand in hand in the Caribbean as different styles combine forming unique masterpieces that have us all dancing in no time. Get ready to dance to the sound of music, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode we’ll continue to follow the action of the 2018 KiteFoil World Series. We’ll reveal the new World Champions crowned in Cagliari, Italy at the final event of the series, the 2018 Sardinia Kiteboard Grand Slam.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: As kiteboarding becomes more popular and accessible to the masses, the hopes of many turn towards the Olympic Games. Although shaken, the spirit of the kiteboarders and their steadfast refusal to be defeated is rewarded with a vote of inclusion for the Youth Games in 2018 for the very first time. Yet again the Olympic dreams of the kiteboarders are on the line as the sport comes up for consideration for the Tokyo Games 2020.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 2
programme.desc: Olympic heroes, America’s Cup winners, Volvo Ocean Race champions and some of sailing’s most capped World Champions gathered in Lagos, in Portugal’s Algarve for the 2019 GC32 World Championship.Taking place with the support of the City of Lagos, Marina de Lagos and Sopromar, this year’s GC32 World Championship was the second event of the 2019 GC32 Racing Tour, following on from last month’s GC32 Villasimius Cup. Racing off Lagos takes place in the Atlantic ocean, but the waters here are protected by Cape St Vincent, the most southwestern tip of Europe, which is just 10km away. With sea breeze conditions and flat waters, the GC32 World Championships offered perfect foiling conditions. And with the local organisers familiar with the GC32’s it was set to be one of the best events of 2019.

programme.title: Les Voiles De St Barth - Episode 1
programme.desc: Les Voiles de St. Barth is an excepartional event: a magnificent fleet of 70 boats, including some that are quite out of the ordinary; varied and challenging race courses; perfect weather conditions; suspense right to the last tack in the last race for many classes; and a roster of various shoreside events that were fun for the sailors as well as the local population.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this new episode of Sail-Ho Croatia, we explore the Markaska Riviera. This area is best known for its beautiful natural beaches and amazing gastronomic delights. Makarska is the center of the Markaska riviera, and it is a hub of culture, education and tourism. Let's discover it!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! The city of Split was formed around the Roman Emperor Diocletian's Palace, and this was built as his retirement residence. However, we have certainly found it as one of the most exciting, fun and action-packed places in the Adriatic. Let's catch up on Split's action!

programme.title: Colours Of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Guadeloupe: the French overseas paradise in the southern Caribbean Sea. Clear blue waters, green vegetation and vibrant people bring out a whole rainbow of emotions in a limited island. Find out the true colours that wrap Guadeloupe with local guide Rudy as we dive into the cultural vibes of the country. From open markets to the local fishmongers and fishermen encircled by pelicans, Guadeloupe is full of secrets only locals know about. Rudy is determined to unveil them and share with us his passion for his beloved island while driving past the volcanic beaches that surround it.Get ready to meet local friends and hear their stories while discovering the Colours of Guadeloupe, now on Nautical Channel.

programme.desc: In this new episode of Sail-Ho Croatia, we explore the Markaska Riviera. This area is best known for its beautiful natural beaches and amazing gastronomic delights. Makarska is the center of the Markaska riviera, and it is a hub of culture, education and tourism. Let's discover it!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! The city of Split was formed around the Roman Emperor Diocletian's Palace, and this was built as his retirement residence. However, we have certainly found it as one of the most exciting, fun and action-packed places in the Adriatic. Let's catch up on Split's action!

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 2
programme.desc: Olympic heroes, America’s Cup winners, Volvo Ocean Race champions and some of sailing’s most capped World Champions gathered in Lagos, in Portugal’s Algarve for the 2019 GC32 World Championship.Taking place with the support of the City of Lagos, Marina de Lagos and Sopromar, this year’s GC32 World Championship was the second event of the 2019 GC32 Racing Tour, following on from last month’s GC32 Villasimius Cup. Racing off Lagos takes place in the Atlantic ocean, but the waters here are protected by Cape St Vincent, the most southwestern tip of Europe, which is just 10km away. With sea breeze conditions and flat waters, the GC32 World Championships offered perfect foiling conditions. And with the local organisers familiar with the GC32’s it was set to be one of the best events of 2019.

programme.title: Les Voiles De St Barth - Episode 1
programme.desc: Les Voiles de St. Barth is an excepartional event: a magnificent fleet of 70 boats, including some that are quite out of the ordinary; varied and challenging race courses; perfect weather conditions; suspense right to the last tack in the last race for many classes; and a roster of various shoreside events that were fun for the sailors as well as the local population.

programme.title: Colours Of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Guadeloupe: the French overseas paradise in the southern Caribbean Sea. Clear blue waters, green vegetation and vibrant people bring out a whole rainbow of emotions in a limited island. Find out the true colours that wrap Guadeloupe with local guide Rudy as we dive into the cultural vibes of the country. From open markets to the local fishmongers and fishermen encircled by pelicans, Guadeloupe is full of secrets only locals know about. Rudy is determined to unveil them and share with us his passion for his beloved island while driving past the volcanic beaches that surround it.Get ready to meet local friends and hear their stories while discovering the Colours of Guadeloupe, now on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.10 - RIJEKA - NOVI VINODOLSKI - NOVIGRAD
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP Spain - Runabout
Tour De France à La Voile 2013
programme.desc: Tour de France a' la voile is an annual yachting race around the coast of France. Inaugurated in 1978, it links the English Channel to the French Riviera and is held in July.

programme.title: Torrevieja Euromarina Optimist International Trophy - XV Trofeo Euromarina Optimist Torrevieja
Formula Kite World Championships - Ep.1 - Sardinia (Italy)
Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives - Episode 5
programme.desc: In tonight's episode the Clipper Race fleet takes on the Asia Pacific Leg, split across two stages with spectacular destinations in China; crews celebrate the Chinese New Year at sea and swelter in the backing tropical heat; there's a second visit by King Neptune as father and son cross the equator and loved ones missed on Valentines Day.

programme.title: Guadeloupe: Caribbean Blues
programme.desc: A visit to Guadeloupe is like visiting all corners of our world’s beauty. Looking to the left you can catch a breeze that swifts a kite surfer in the air, and to the right a gust of smoke from the Soufriere’s volcanic top. Everything in between is a perfectly balanced mixture of colour, tradition, and a lifestyle to die for.Guadeloupe: Caribbean Blues takes us on a trip to this dreamy destination. Rhythm and music go hand in hand in the Caribbean as different styles combine forming unique masterpieces that have us all dancing in no time. Get ready to dance to the sound of music, on Nautical Channel.

Yet again the Olympic dreams of the kiteboarders are on the line as the sport comes up for consideration for the Tokyo Games 2020.
